SSC GD Answer Key 2026 Out @ssc.gov.in

The SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026 has been released by the Staff Selection Commission on 15th June 2026. The commission has activated the SSC GD answer key download link on its website. Candidates can see the answers marked in the exam and guess their scores before the result is announced with their login details. This is the provisional answer key and candidates can raise objections if they think there is an incorrect answer. The Commission has activated the objection window from 15th June to 20th June 2026. Students need to pay ₹50 per question to raise objections.

How To Download ssc gov in GD Answer Key 2026?

Candidates can download the SSC GD Answer Key from the link given above or from the official website online by following few simple steps. Download the response sheet and have your login information ready.

  1. Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Go to login page.
  3. Enter your Registration Number and Password.
  4. Fill in the captcha code carefully.
  5. Click on the “Login” button.
  6. The SSC GD Response Sheet and answer key will appear on the screen.
  7. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

How to Calculate SSC GD Constable 2026 Marks Using Answer Key?

The candidates can use the SSC GD Answer Key to calculate their marks before the result is declared. They can then compare answers and use the official marking scheme to calculate marks.

  • Add marks for every correct answer.
  • Reduce 0.25 marks for every wrong answer.
  • Leave unanswered questions without adding marks.
  • Calculate the total score carefully.
  • Compare your marks with the expected cut off.

SSC GD Response Sheet 2026

The SSC GD Response Sheet 2026 has been released along with the tentative answer key. It allows candidates to view the answers they marked during the Computer Based Exam. Candidates can estimate their expected scores by comparing their responses with the answer key. The response sheet is available through the SSC candidate login portal and can be downloaded for personal reference and self-analysis before the objection window closes on 20th June 2026.

SSC GD Answer Key 2026 Notice: Click Here to Download

ssc gov in Constable Answer Key Raise Objection Window

SSC has also opened the objection window along with the release of the SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026. If candidates find any error in the provisional answer key, they can challenge it online within the given deadline i.e. 20th June 2026. Candidates need to give valid proof or supporting documents while submitting objections. Staff Selection Commission will release the final SSC GD anskey after checking all challenges. No objections will be accepted after the closing date of the objection window.

Event Date & Time
SSC GD Answer Key Release 15th June 2026 (06:00 PM)
Objection Window Opens 15th June 2026 (06:00 PM)

Objection Fee ₹50 per question

How To Challenge SSC GD Answer Key 2026?

Students who find any error in the GD CBT exam can raise objections against the provisional response sheet via ssc portal. The challenge window will remain active from 15th June to 20th June 2026 by paying ₹50 per question. No objections will be accepted once the challenge window closes at 6:00 P.M. on 20th June 2026.

  1. Go to the official SSC website @ssc.gov.in.
  2. Use your Registration number and password to login.
  3. Click on SSC GD Answer Key objection link.
  4. Select the question you want to challenge.
  5. Upload valid proof or explanation.
  6. Pay ₹50 objection fee.
  7. Submit the objection form successfully.

Details to Check on SSC GD Answer Key PDF

Candidates should properly review all details mentioned in the SSC GD 2026 Answer Key PDF and response sheet. Knowing these information helps to make sure that the answer key belongs to the correct candidate and examination shift.

  • Roll Number- A unique identification number given to the candidate.
  • Candidate Name – The name of the candidate who appeared for the exam.
  • Exam Name– The examination for which the answer key and response sheet have been issued.
  • Exam Date – The date on which the SSC GD examination was held.
  • Test Time & Shift – The timing and shift allotted to the candidate.
  • Centre Name – The exam venue address where the test was held.
  • Green Colour Code – States a correct answer selected by the candidate.
  • Red Colour Code – Indicates an incorrect answer selected by the candidate.
  • Yellow Colour Code – Shows the correct option for a question.
  • Grey Colour Code – Tells questions that were left unanswered.

SSC GD PET/PHT 2026

Candidates who qualify in the Computer Based Examination (CBE) will be called for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test. The PET/PST tests are to see the candidate’s physical fitness and eligibility for the GD Constable post. The PET has running events, while the PHT measures physical standards such as height & chest (for male candidates). Candidates should meet the prescribed standards to get selected.

SSC GD Final Answer Key 2026

The SSC GD Final Answer Key will be released after the Commission goes through all objections submitted against the tentative answer key. It will have the final and revised answers accepted by SSC. Candidates may take help of the final answer key to know their performance and compare it with the result. The SSC GD Result 2026 will be prepared based on the final answer key, making it an important document for all candidates.

SSC GD Constable Expected Cut Off 2026

The SSC GD Constable expected cut off 2026 gives candidates an idea about their selection chances for the next stage. The cut off may vary based on category, exam difficulty level and number of candidates.

Category Expected Cut Off Marks
General 138 – 145
OBC 133 – 140
EWS 130 – 138
SC 122 – 128
ST 115 – 122

SSC GD Constable Result 2026

The SSC GD Constable Result 2026 will be announced a few days after the release of the final answer key. Candidates who clear the CBT stage will be called for PET/PST rounds. The result will be released online in PDF format containing the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates. Along with the result, SSC may also release the category wise cut off marks.

SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026 FAQs

Q1. When was the SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026 released?

Ans: The SSC GD Answer Key 2026 is released on 15th June 2026.

Q2. From where do I download the SSC GD Response Sheet?

Ans: You can download it from the ssc gd answer key 2026 link given in the page above or from ssc.gov.in portal.

Q3. What information is needed to check the SSC GD 2026 Answer Key PDF?

Ans: Candidates should have their Registration No. & Password to login and get the SSC GD answer key PDF.

Q4. Is there any way to challenge SSC GD anskey 2026?

Ans: Yes candidates can raise objections when the objection window is open. The window will remain active from 15th June to 20th June 2026.

Q5. What is the next stage after SSC GD CBT?

Ans: Candidates who get selected will undergo PET/PST/medical test.

Q6. How many number of posts are there for the post of SSC GD Constable 2026 recruitment?

Ans: The total number of vacancies declared is 25,487.
